newsitem.title: UK: BT shares see one of heaviest trading days.
newsitem.headline: BT shares see one of heaviest trading days.

text.p: Volume in British Telecommunications Plc was approaching 140 million shares by 1252 GMT on Friday after a profit warning from merger partner MCI overnight.
The volume was the third highes daily total since the company floated in 1984. On 20 and 21 March this year, volume was 225 million and 416 million respectively.
Friday's volume represented one percent of the company's shares at issue.
The stock fell 50p to 427-1/2p, the session's low, as analysts cut profit estimates for the year by 10 percent to around four billion stg.
MCI shares plunged to $34-1/8 from $42-3/8 in pre-opening trade in New York.
